cards.ex: We bought a fixer-upper for a really good price.
cards.exUz: Biz juda yaxshi narxga ta'mir talab uy sotib oldik.

cards.ex: When are you planning to move in to your new apartment?
cards.exUz: Yangi kvartirangizga qachon ko'chib o'tmoqchisiz?
cards.uzDef: Yangi joyga yashash uchun ko'chib kelmoq.

cards.ex: I'm moving out of my parents' house next month.
cards.exUz: Keyingi oy ota-onamning uyidan ko'chib ketyapman.

cards.ex: After years of traveling, they decided to settle down in Italy.
cards.exUz: Ko'p yillik sayohatdan so'ng, ular Italiyada o'rnashib qolishga qaror qilishdi.

cards.ex: We're having a housewarming party next Saturday, you should come!
cards.exUz: Kelgusi shanba kuni uy to'yimiz bor, kelishingiz kerak!

cards.ex: They're ready to put down roots and start a family.
cards.exUz: Ular ildiz otishga va oila qurishga tayyor.
cards.uzDef: Bir joyda uzoq vaqt yashashni boshlamoq.

cards.ex: We need to sign the lease before we can get the keys.
cards.exUz: Kalitlarni olishimizdan oldin ijara shartnomasini imzolashimiz kerak.

cards.ex: Read the rental agreement carefully before you sign it.
cards.exUz: Imzolashdan oldin ijara kelishuvini diqqat bilan o'qing.

cards.ex: Property value has increased significantly in this area.
cards.exUz: Bu hududda mulk qiymati sezilarli darajada oshdi.

cards.ex: We're struggling to keep up with our mortgage payments.
cards.exUz: Biz ipoteka to'lovlarini to'lashga qiynalyapmiz.

cards.ex: The housing market is very competitive right now.
cards.exUz: Hozir uy-joy bozori juda raqobatbardosh.
cards.uzDef: Uylar sotiladigan va sotib olinadigan bozor.

cards.ex: Our real estate agent helped us find the perfect house.
cards.exUz: Bizning rieltorimiz bizga mukammal uyni topishga yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: Uy sotish yoki sotib olishda yordam beradigan shaxs.

cards.ex: We need to save up for a down payment before we can buy a house.
cards.exUz: Uy sotib olishimizdan oldin boshlang'ich to'lov uchun pul yig'ishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Uyni sotib olish uchun dastlabki to'lov.

cards.ex: Don't forget to get homeowner's insurance.
cards.exUz: Uy sug'urtasini olishni unutmang.

cards.ex: Property tax rates are high in this area.
cards.exUz: Bu hududda mulk solig'i stavkalari yuqori.

cards.ex: Our landlord is very responsive to our requests.
cards.exUz: Bizning uy egamiz bizning so'rovlarimizga juda tez javob beradi.

cards.ex: The tenants in the building are very friendly.
cards.exUz: Binodagi ijarachilar juda do'stona.

cards.ex: Rental income can be a good source of passive income.
cards.exUz: Ijara daromadi passiv daromadning yaxshi manbai bo'lishi mumkin.

cards.ex: Utilities are included in the rent.
cards.exUz: Kommunal xizmatlar ijara narxiga kiritilgan.

cards.ex: Make sure you understand the terms of the lease agreement.
cards.exUz: Ijara shartnomasi shartlarini tushunganingizga ishonch hosil qiling.
cards.uzDef: Uyni ijaraga olish shartlari yozilgan hujjat.

cards.ex: We need to pay a security deposit before we move in.
cards.exUz: Ko'chib kirishdan oldin garov puli to'lashimiz kerak.

cards.ex: The master bedroom has a huge walk-in closet.
cards.exUz: Asosiy yotoqxonada juda katta ichki shkaf bor.
cards.uzDef: Ichiga kirish mumkin bo'lgan katta shkaf.

cards.ex: Landscaping can greatly improve a home's curb appeal.
cards.exUz: Landshaft dizayni uyning tashqi ko'rinishini sezilarli darajada yaxshilashi mumkin.

cards.ex: We're having an open house this Sunday.
cards.exUz: Bu yakshanba ochiq eshiklar kunini o'tkazamiz.

cards.ex: We recommend getting a home inspection before you buy.
cards.exUz: Sotib olishdan oldin uyni tekshirtirishni tavsiya qilamiz.

cards.ex: We finally closed on our new house yesterday!
cards.exUz: Kecha nihoyat yangi uyimizning xaridini yakunladik!

cards.ex: At least we have a roof over our heads.
cards.exUz: Hech bo'lmasa, boshpanamiz bor.

cards.ex: It's hard to get on the property ladder these days.
cards.exUz: Hozirgi kunda mulk narvoniga chiqish qiyin.

cards.ex: Renter's insurance is pretty cheap and worth it.
cards.exUz: Ijarachilar sug'urtasi juda arzon va arziydi.

cards.ex: The square footage of the apartment is about 800.
cards.exUz: Kvartiraning maydoni taxminan 800 kvadrat fut.
